0022600150.text: The Memphis Grizzlies, unbeaten at 5-0 and on a five-game winning streak, host the Sacramento Kings, who are 0-5 and have lost five straight, with Memphis sitting 2nd in the Southwest and 2nd in the West while Sacramento is 15th in the West and 5th in the Pacific, 4 games back. Memphis is without Quinten Post (ankle), Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness) and Ty Jerome (back soreness), all listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Sacramento has Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee) ruled out. Memphis won the last meeting 123-112 in Sacramento on October 25, leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0, and won the 2025-26 series 3-1.
